== Biography ==
William Glasgow was born on 4 August 1765 in Swinton and Simprin, Berwickshire, Scotland. He was the son of James Glasgow and Elizabeth Tait.<ref>Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950. MyHeritage.com [online database], accessed 2025. https://www.myheritage.com/research/record-30226-1373042/william-glasgow-in-scotland-births-baptisms.</ref>  

William Glasgow married Catherine Nisbet. He passed away on 15 January 1820 in Kirknewton and East Calder, Midlothian, Scotland.

* [[Glasgow-1326|John Glasgow (abt.1798-)]], baptized 13 January 1798, Kirknewton and East Calder, Midlothian<ref>Baptism Index, ScotlandsPeople, Old Parish Registers, Kirknewton and East Calder, 1798, entry 690/30 124.</ref>
* [[Glasgow-1324|Magdaline Glasgow (bef.1800-)]]
* [[Glasgow-1325|James Glasgow (bef.1804-)]], baptized 29 January 1804, Kirknewton and East Calder, Midlothian<ref>Baptism Index, ScotlandsPeople, Old Parish Registers, Kirknewton and East Calder, 1804, entry 690/30 135.</ref>
* [[Glasgow-1224|Catherine Glasgow (bef.1805–abt.1877)]], baptized 9 September 1805, Kirknewton and East Calder, Midlothian<ref>Baptism Index, ScotlandsPeople, Old Parish Registers, Kirknewton and East Calder, 1805, entry 690/30 140.</ref>
